summary: Configured node1 with HAProxy on port 80 forwarding to a Node.js application bound only to 127.0.0.1:3000. The endpoint returns HTTP 200 with body `infraset-nodejs`, and the application is managed by the enabled `infraset-nodejs.service`. Configuration persisted across a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Created a dedicated infraset-nodejs system user and application.
Configured, validated, enabled, and started HAProxy.
Verified listeners and HTTP responses before and after reboot.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.

evidence.requirement: Node.js application is managed as infraset-nodejs.service
evidence.summary: Service was enabled and active under the dedicated infraset-nodejs account with automatic restart configured.

evidence.requirement: HAProxy serves HTTP on port 80 and forwards to loopback port 3000
evidence.summary: HAProxy configuration validated; listeners showed HAProxy on *:80 and Node.js only on 127.0.0.1:3000.

evidence.requirement: Endpoint returns HTTP 200 with body infraset-nodejs
evidence.summary: Requests through node1's managed IP returned HTTP/1.1 200 OK and the exact 15-byte body before and after reboot.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 35c87ec9-1707-4fb3-ab1d-f264d3618caa, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID 2d464dc4-100c-4a9a-b1a9-419f23937fbd, and recovered active services, listeners, and HTTP responses.
